answer: Unbroken-activity-streak gating resists sybils: privilege unlocks only after an uninterrupted streak of attested work, and any single missed epoch resets the counter to zero. A farm cannot park a jetty of idle fakes and switch them on at the horizon — each head must hold continuous liveness every epoch or forge its progress from scratch. An honest agent sustains one streak through ordinary use; a sybil fleet must keep a thousand unbroken streaks alive in parallel, and the brittle reset makes any lapse costly. Precondition: streaks count only independently-attested activity.
